rule: margin = commit - image - linear - soc - leave - rom_need, with image = static + loader. static = page_up(__end__) - __start__ from the map (text, rodata, data, bss). The game computes the same sum at boot: heap = commit - image - linear - soc (pm_mem.c __system_allocateHeaps), cap = heap - leave, the ROM fits when cap >= rom_need (pm_os.c pm_rom_init). memcheck prints OK when margin >= safety, else OVER. OVER is a warning: push_3ds.sh stops unless --mem-ok.
safety_why: The loader cost on the console is bracketed to 0..100 KB (loader_kb uses the middle, 50 KB, so 50 KB of the safety covers the bracket); the commit limit is from one older boot line, and an HBL or system update can move both: the other 206 KB cover that drift. 256 KB is still small next to one static buffer of the size that broke build 3299 (413 KB).

code._note: memcheck.py reads these from the source and warns when this copy is stale.

linear_kb.src: 3ds/src/pm_mem.c PM_OURS 14 MB minus PM_SOC: the linearAlloc pool

soc_kb.src: 3ds/src/pm_mem.c PM_SOC: socket block at 0x08000000, out of the same commit

fcram_cap_kb.src: 3ds/src/pm_mem.c PM_FCRAM: avail = commit - image is capped here

leave_kb.src: 3ds/src/pm_os.c pm_rom_init leave: heap kept for the game after the ROM block

o3ds_xl.desc: O3DS XL 192.168.1.131, Homebrew Launcher started through Download Play (applet mode, APPLICATION region 64 MB)

commit_kb.src: O3DS boot line of build 926: mem commit limit 65536KB used-by-image 19592KB (docs/plans/topology.md). Build 3299 agrees (below).

loader_kb.src: image = static + loader. Build 3299 (static 22040 KB) stopped with free 25 MB: cap in [25602, 25746] KB (cap >> 20 = 25, cap < rom_need, heap page aligned), so commit - image in [43396, 43540] KB and, with commit 65536, loader in [0, 100] KB. Build 3212 (static 21616 KB) booted: loader <= 376 KB. The middle of the bracket, 50 KB, is used; the safety covers the rest. Azahar measures image - static = 16 KB (direct 3dsx load, no HBL).

region_kb.src: O3DS APPLICATION region in the default memory mode; the boot line field region replaces it

o3ds_xl.replace_with: the next O3DS boot line 'mem boot:': commit -> commit_kb, image - static -> loader_kb, region -> region_kb; then mark them measured
